title: kb_http read_chunked answers 413 to a body under --max-body when its chunks are small, because the framing allowance is a flat 4 KiB
goal: kb_http.Handler.read_chunked serves a chunked body whose data is at or under --max-body whatever its chunk size (a 1 MiB body in 256-byte chunks carries about 28 KiB of chunk-size lines), while a body whose framing, extensions and trailers run far past the limit still gets 413; a test plants both; found by the SP-4i5quwba review of BG-qxoozn4n

run:
import sys,io;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_http;h=object.__new__(kb_http.Handler);h.rfile=io.BytesIO(b''.join(b'100
'+b'x'*256+b'
' for _ in range(4096))+b'0

');sys.exit(0 if h.read_chunked(1<<20) is not None else 1)
